Subject : Update on the Conference Call in respect of Financial Results for the quarter ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
In furtherance of our letter dated October 16, 2026, informing the Exchanges regarding the Earnings call in 
respect of the Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, we wish to 
inform that the said conference call was held today, i.e., October 22, 2026.  
The presentation made to the participants has already been disclosed to the Exchanges vide our letter 
dated October 22, 2026. The audio recording of Paisalo's Q2FY27 Earnings call has been hosted on the 
website of the Company and is available at https://www.paisalo.in/Content/Audio/2026-27_q2.mp4  
We request you to take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Paisalo Digital Limited 
 
 
 
(MANENDRA SINGH) 
Company Secretary
